nozh.config.tooltip.graph: Frame Time History (Green=60+ FPS, Red=<30 FPS)
nozh.config.tooltip.enabled:
Master Switch.
Disables ALL optimizations instantly.
Use this if you suspect Nozh is breaking a specific mechanism.
nozh.config.tooltip.autotuning:
Auto-Tuning.
Allows Nozh to change settings automatically during gameplay
without asking for confirmation first.
nozh.config.tooltip.rollback:
Safety Feature.
If an optimization causes FPS to DROP instead of rise,
Nozh will automatically undo it within 45 seconds.
nozh.config.tooltip.targetfps:
The FPS goal Nozh tries to reach.
Higher targets = More aggressive degradation of visuals.
nozh.config.tooltip.adaptive_quality:
Dynamic Resolution scaling for visual effects.
Reduces particles and draw distance when FPS drops.
Restores them when FPS is high.
nozh.config.tooltip.sensitivity:
Lag Tolerance.
Lower = Reacts faster to small lags.
Higher = Smoother but reacts slowly.
nozh.config.tooltip.debug:
Spammy Logs.
Writes detailed decision data to the log file.
Enable ONLY if reporting a bug.
nozh.config.tooltip.safemode_force:
Emergency Switch.
Forces minimal settings regardless of profile.
Use if crashing repeatedly.
nozh.config.tooltip.rollback_enabled:
If performance degrades after a change,
automatically revert it within 45s.
nozh.config.tooltip.hybrid:
Combines rule-based safety with neural predictions.
Recommended: ON.
nozh.config.tooltip.benchmark:
Periodically runs standard scenarios
to calibrate your hardware baseline.
nozh.config.tooltip.history_limit:
Number of past decisions to remember.
Higher = Smarter but more RAM usage.
nozh.config.tooltip.decision_budget:
Max CPU time allowed per decision.
Start low (5ms) for weak CPUs.
nozh.config.tooltip.export_config: Copy current config JSON to clipboard.
nozh.config.tooltip.reload_config: Discard unsaved changes and reload file.
